classification.difficultyReason: Match vertices across differently oriented and intersecting triangles using marked/vertical/right angles, then apply corresponding-side ratios; the adapted fourth part retains the same routine linked decisions.

content.prompt: For each part, write a similarity statement with the vertices in the correct order. Then find the value of each unknown side length.

spec.description: Two upright isosceles triangles, larger on the left; all six side labels and both alpha labels retained. Ordinary source-blue outlines use house black.
spec.mathematics: AB=BC=8 cm, AC=6 cm; DE=EF=6 cm, DF=g cm; angle A equals angle D.

answer.worked:
Both triangles are isosceles. Their marked base angles are equal, so their other base angles and their apex angles are equal. Thus $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEF$ (AAA).
$$\begin{align*}\frac{g}{6}&=\frac{6}{8}\\g&=6\times\frac{6}{8}\\g&=\frac92\text{ cm}=4.5\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Paired right triangles with corresponding vertical and horizontal legs; larger triangle on the left. Ordinary outlines and marks use black.
spec.mathematics: Right angles at P and S; alpha at M and Q; MN=7.5 mm, MP=a mm, PN=b mm, QS=4 mm, SR=3 mm, QR=5 mm.

answer.worked:
The marked angles and the right angles correspond, so $\triangle MNP\sim\triangle QRS$ (AAA).
$$\begin{align*}\frac{a}{4}&=\frac{7.5}{5}\\a&=4\times\frac{7.5}{5}\\a&=6\text{ mm}\\\frac{b}{3}&=\frac{7.5}{5}\\b&=3\times\frac{7.5}{5}\\b&=4.5\text{ mm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Separate differently oriented triangles, GHI left and JKL right, retaining all lengths and marked angle correspondences. Ordinary geometry uses black.
spec.mathematics: GH=12 cm, GI=5 cm, HI=m cm; JK=2 cm, KL=1 cm, JL=n cm; H corresponds to J and I to K.

answer.worked:
The marked $\alpha$ and $\beta$ angles correspond, so $\triangle GHI\sim\triangle LJK$ (AAA).
$$\begin{align*}\frac{m}{2}&=\frac{5}{1}\\m&=2\times5\\m&=10\text{ cm}\\\frac{n}{12}&=\frac{1}{5}\\n&=\frac{12}{5}\\n&=2.4\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Approved adaptation: two nondegenerate similar triangles across C; A-C-D and B-C-E remain straight. Coordinates verify small sides2,3,4 and opposing scale3.5copy7,10.5,14.
spec.mathematics: AB=2cm, AC=4cm (human-approved adaptation from5), BC=qcm, CD=pcm, CE=10.5cm, DE=7cm; equal beta angles atB/E. Originalsourceunchanged; not confirmed publisher errata.

answer.worked:
The marked angles at $B$ and $E$ are equal, and $\angle ACB=\angle DCE$ (vertically opposite angles). Thus $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEC$ (AAA).
$$\begin{align*}\frac{p}{4}&=\frac{7}{2}\\p&=4\times\frac72\\p&=14\text{ cm}\\\frac{q}{10.5}&=\frac{2}{7}\\q&=10.5\times\frac27\\q&=3\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
